info.name: CRM Lite
info.description: CRM Lite backend API collection. Import together with CRM-Lite.local.postman_environment.json and read docs/postman/README.md for startup order, execution order and how dynamic variables are populated. AUTHENTICATION (ADR-006..008): every business request through the gateway needs a logged-in BFF session (Authorization Code + PKCE via the browser — see folder 09 and the README §Authentication). Direct Grant/ROPC is disabled by design; never store passwords or tokens in this collection.

item.name: 09 - Authentication (session probe and logout)
item.description: The gateway is a cookie-session BFF (ADR-007): it does NOT accept Authorization: Bearer. Log in once via the BROWSER (http://localhost:8080/api/session/me -> Keycloak login ayilmaz/crm-dev), then copy the JSESSIONID and XSRF-TOKEN cookie values from browser devtools into Postman: Cookies (below the Send button) -> Add domain localhost -> add both cookies for port 8080. Postman then sends them automatically; set the xsrfToken environment variable to the XSRF-TOKEN value for unsafe requests (folders 04/05/06 write operations). Full contract: docs/api/authentication.md.

request.description: RP-initiated logout (ADR-007/008): kills the gateway session synchronously and returns 200 with {logoutUrl} — Keycloak's end_session endpoint. A GET to logoutUrl completes the Keycloak SSO logout and lands on Keycloak's sign-in form, since post_logout_redirect_uri is the gateway's /oauth2/authorization/keycloak (the app does this via window.location.replace, after the user confirms the sign-out dialog; this request alone only ends the gateway session). Requires the session cookies plus xsrfToken set from the XSRF-TOKEN cookie.

item.name: 11 - Products and Catalog (FR-PROD)
item.description: FR-PROD-01..02 (§2.6) + the read-only offer/campaign catalog, served by product-service (port 8086, product_db). Read-only slice: no product creation, provisioning, basket or order exists. GET /api/products composes over account-service's internal /api/accounts/{n}/product-ids endpoint, because PROD carries no account column — the product↔account link lives only in account_db.cust_acct_prod_invl (ADR-013 §5). All requests are GETs, so no X-XSRF-TOKEN header is needed; a logged-in BFF session is still required (folder 09).
